violations.description: CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not to be further cooked. Raw salmon noted sitting on top of a container of ready-to-eat salsa. Product removed and training on the topic to correct the critical violation.

COOKING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (5 pts): Raw chicken was noted as not being properly cooked to a final internal cooking temperature of 165?F to destroy potentially harmful bacteria. To correct the violation the chicken was placed back on the grill. Extensive conversations were had with managment on-site regarding the proper use of a food thermometer to temp TCS foods. It was explained that one possible solution is to create a ''test piece'' of meat that is larger than the other pieces on the same skewer. When this ''test piece'' is temped and reaches the appropriate temperature in this case 165?F for chicken you can reasonably determine that all other smaller pieces of meat on the same skewer have also reached the appropriate final cooking temperature. The other option is to temp every single piece of meat on the skewer if there is not an obviously larger piece. It was also noted that the pieces of meat closest to the handle of the skewer were not as warm as the rest. Therefore it was also recommended that the larger ''test piece'' of meat be placed in this location to help ensure the rest of the skewer is cooked to the appropriate final cooking temperature.

DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): The three compartment sink was noted not being properly operated. Sanitizer was noted in the middle compartment. The labeling on the sink is correct and should be followed.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Raw salmon was noted thawing while still inside its vacuum-sealed packaging. Per FDA Food Code ? 3-501.13(E) reduced oxygen packaged fish bearing a label indicating it must be kept frozen until time of use must be removed from the reduced oxygen environment prior to thawing under refrigeration. The salmon must be completely removed from its packaging before thawing continues.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw beef noted stored over parsley and pineapple. Parsley and pineapple are ready-to-eat food items and do not require cooking therefore raw meats are never to be stored over top of them. Raw meats are to be separated and stored according to final cooking temperature from bottom to top as follows: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat/pre-cooked items on top. Critical violation corrected with education on the topic and rearranging the food items.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the front service area. Soap was replaced to correct the critical violation. Soap and Paper towels are to be replaced immediately when running out.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Can opener slicer and utensil drawer noted not properly maintained.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensils noted being stored with the handles laying in the almonds and pecans.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Reach-in cooler door handle noted not in good repair.

FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Beef and cheese sauce noted not being held at 140 degrees fahrenheit or above in hot boxes. The food was allowed to be removed from the hot box and returned to 165?F due to the short time frame from the cooking process. The hot box temperature was increased to 145?F to correct the violation. | FOOD DISPLAY SERVICE AND TRANSPORT TEMP (5 pts): Hot holding units on the hot buffet line noted not being held at 140 degrees fahrenheit or above. Cooked rice mixture noted at 116?F. Upon further inspection the water level in the warmer was too low not allowing for proper hot holding. Critical violation corrected with education on the topic.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw pork skewers noted stored above raw shrimp skewers. Raw meats are to be seperated and stored according to final cooking temperature from bottom to top as follows: chicken beef pork seafood and all ready-to-eat/pre-cooked items on top. Critical violation corrected with education on the topic.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the employee restroom. Soap was replaced to correct the violation. | HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory in the ware-washing area noted with no hot water provided. The handle is missing from the handsink and the hot water cannot be turned on.
